caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object consisting of two flat, elongated arms made of textured, dark gray material. Each arm is bent at a right angle near the base and terminates in a curled, upward-facing hook at the top, creating a symmetrical form. The two arms are connected by a wide, slightly curved strip of the same material positioned horizontally between them. Each base of the arms extends outward, lying flat and featuring two round holes. The drawing uses shades of gray and black to render the object realistically, with attention to the surface texture and resulting shadows, and is set against a plain off-white or beige background. The artist's signature, "Julius Bellamy," is visible in small letters in the lower left corner.
title: Foot Scraper
